card.name: Single-use vial restriction wording
card.fires_on: Words inside instructions that a single-dose vial or syringe is for one session, one patient or one eye, such as 'during one', 'only for', 'only'. Also fires weakly on 'Do not use' and a few unrelated spots such as 'in question' or digits in numbers.

modes.label: Single-use vial rule
modes.description: Words in the sentence limiting a vial or syringe to one session, patient or eye.
modes.example: Each single-dose vial should only be used during<< one>> session and only for one patient.

modes.label: Scattered other spots
modes.description: Stray words in non-label text or digits inside numbers, with no shared theme.
